verdict.rationale: Lorikeet lets users build, edit, and deploy workflows, including via natural language over MCP. Side-by-side simulation batch comparisons let users review how a workflow edit changed outcomes before deploying, which covers the review part of the story. Nothing in the evidence shows explicit workflow versioning, a version history, or rollback to a prior version. Missing for 10: explicit workflow version history, diff of workflow definitions, one-click rollback, independent corroboration.
